key_insight: Random splits can reward recipe memorisation, while provenance-grouped evaluation reveals which models generalise to unseen institutions and future discoveries.
engineering_relevance: Reliable solar-cell optimisation requires evaluating models beyond familiar recipes and considering device architecture and fabrication alongside absorber chemistry.
method: Map institutional provenance in the Perovskite Database.
Apply hierarchical grouped splits isolating duplicate devices, publications and institutions.
Benchmark 13 models and examine feature importance.
evidence_signal: Nearly two-thirds of curated devices share an exact recipe with another; tree ensembles lead on random splits, but composition-aware neural models excel on unseen institutions and future discoveries.
watch_item: Implementing provenance-grouped evaluation depends on reliable recipe deduplication and publication-to-institution mapping.
paper_title: Provenance-grouped protocol for evaluating machine learning in perovskite photovoltaics
